verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents an API with more than 120 actions, an MCP server and separate sandbox keys. Nothing in the evidence shows it can issue API credentials limited to specific actions, domains or permissions for an agent. Separate sandbox keys isolate a test environment rather than scoping access, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
